sections.title: iOS Programming
sections.description: This project-oriented course is centered around application development on current iOS mobile platforms. The first half of the course will involve fundamentals of mobile app development, where students learn about mobile app lifecycles, event-based programming, efficient resource management, and how to interact with the range of sensors available on modern mobile devices. In the second half of the course, students work in teams to conceptualize and develop a significant mobile application. Creativity and originality are highly encouraged! Prerequisite: CIS 1200 or previous programming experience.
